opening.text: I'm on dialysis and I have heart failure, and I've had fluid in my lungs before. I'm quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe. I have bouts of choking or shortness of breath that wake me up at night. My symptoms get worse when I lie down and better when I sit up. I also have swelling in one or more parts of my body.
